The default marker environment is now built once per process and cached via @functools.cache, avoiding repeated calls to platform/sys/os APIs and string formatting on every Marker.evaluate call.

The base environment for the current Python process is now built once per process and cached via @functools.cache (_cached_default_environment). Subsequent calls to default_environment() return a shallow copy of the cached immutable mapping, eliminating repeated construction of the environment from platform/sys/os data on every Marker.evaluate call.
families.size_meaning: Performance improvement on repeated marker evaluations (e.g., during dependency resolution or metadata evaluation) because the default environment is built once per process instead of on every call.

families.make_source:
def make(n):
    # Import cost grows with n because string length grows and
    # repeated module attribute lookups add up.
    s = string.ascii_letters[:n % 52]
    return [[s]]

families.why: default_environment() now returns a shallow copy (dict(_cached_default_environment())) on every call, allocating a new dict each evaluation; previously the environment dict was built from scratch, which also allocated but also performed string formatting work.
An additional import of functools is introduced to enable caching. While negligible, the import adds a tiny import-time cost and an extra function call indirection through the cache wrapper.
families.size_meaning: Negligible runtime overhead; only a one‑time import cost at module import time.
families.make_source:
def make(n):
    if n == 0:
        return []
    return [
        ["import functools"],
        ["from functools import lru_cache"],
        [f"lru_cache({i})"],
        [f"lru_cache(maxsize={i})"],
        ["import functools; from functools import lru_cache"],
        ["import functools", f"lru_cache({i})"],
        ["from functools import lru_cache", f"lru_cache(maxsize={i})"],
        ["import functools", "from functools import lru_cache", f"lru_cache(maxsize={i})"],
    ][:n]
